_comment: Tool registry for the flagship_v3 cognitive-core post-training (idea #4). Single source of truth: consumed by scripts/gen_teacher_data.py (data), src/tool_data.py (SFT formatting), src/grammar.py (constrained decoding) and scripts/tool_eval.py (eval). Response protocol is a mode discriminator followed by content: 'TOOL {json}' for a call, 'ANSWER <text>' for a direct reply. Types: string | number | enum.
